prepared_policy: Replay histories fit250bytes and contain complete entries followed by a zero-filled unused tail.
Prepared append receives the native imaginary classification as a semantic byte; every value except1 selects a twenty-byte result.
Normal capacity no-ops are preserved; byte-length wrapping, unterminated sources and the native251-byte finder overflow are rejected before replay mutation.
Recall uses an admitted1-based8113 index and at most99 expression bytes; the caller's count/mode admission is required.
Native CPU stack bytes are excluded; prepared append/recall otherwise compare whole RAM and callbacks. Convenience append explicitly excludes native numeric operand scratch8000..80db.
Supplied variable records are immutable host values. Use the address adapter for calculator RAM sources and native forward-copy overlap semantics.
gaps: Full event-handler, evaluator source/commit and error-resume orchestration remain with the event controller.
Physical interrupt/timer scheduling remains with the host.
Out-of-range variable slots and native malformed-store/CPU-frame corruption are outside the prepared caller domain.
The convenience replay classifier does not reproduce native CPU register snapshots or incidental numeric operand scratch.
